description: Resource Type definition for AWS::QuickSight::Assignment, which manages an Amazon QuickSight IAM policy assignment that attaches an IAM policy to specified QuickSight users or groups within a namespace.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM policy assignment. This is a synthesized identifier composed of the namespace and assignment name.
Arn.markdownDescription:
The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM policy assignment. This is a synthesized identifier composed of the namespace and assignment name.

---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Pattern: ^arn:[a-z0-9-]+:quicksight:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:assignment/.+$  
Update requires: No interruption
Read only property: Yes

AssignmentId.description: The ID for the IAM policy assignment.
AssignmentId.markdownDescription:
The ID for the IAM policy assignment.

Required: No  
Type: String  
Update requires: No interruption

AssignmentName.description: The name of the assignment, also called a rule. The name must be unique within the AWS account.
AssignmentName.markdownDescription:
The name of the assignment, also called a rule. The name must be unique within the AWS account.

---

Required: Yes  
Type: String

Update requires: Replacement

The status of the assignment.

Required: Yes
